Gate, fence and planting claims cannot simply be added together into a total reduction. Consider the boundary as a whole and compare practical options for the particular source and receiving location.
Check design trade-offs

A closed gate affects views, airflow and wind exposure, and must still provide a suitable entrance for people and vehicles. Ask the gate installer to coordinate any acoustic proposal with the supports, movement and protective measures.

Choose gate materials and layout for the complete entrance. If noise reduction is the main objective, obtain the acoustic assessment before ordering a gate on that promise.

automated-gate-home-insurance.title: Electric Driveway Gates and Home Insurance
automated-gate-home-insurance.description: Ask your insurer how an automated gate affects your policy instead of assuming a premium discount or automatic cover.
sections: Ask about your own policy

There is no insurance discount we can promise for adding a driveway gate. Contact your insurer or broker before relying on the gate as a policy security measure. Describe the proposed installation and any change to property access.

Ask whether you need to notify them when the work is complete and whether the policy contains conditions about operation, locking or maintenance. Request confirmation that you can keep with your policy documents.
Clarify what damage and costs are covered

Ask how the policy treats the gate, motors, controls and underground services. Discuss accidental impact, storm or flood damage, electrical faults, wear, theft and the applicable excesses. These are questions for the insurer, not a list of guaranteed cover.

Check whether a damaged gate that blocks the entrance requires a particular claims process before you arrange repairs. A product warranty and an insurance policy cover different risks.
Keep useful records

Retain the quotation, installed product details, invoice, handover information and service records. Take photographs of the completed entrance and record changes to the equipment.

Use our installed gate cost guide to keep the installed scope clear. If you need repair work, agree the inspection charge and authorisation arrangements while checking any insurer requirements.

driveway-gate-property-value-london.title: Do Driveway Gates Add Value to a London Home?
driveway-gate-property-value-london.description: Consider appearance, parking and upkeep without assuming a guaranteed sale-price increase.
sections: Separate enjoyment from resale value

You may want a gate for privacy, appearance or control over access. Those reasons can justify a project without assuming that a buyer will repay its cost. We do not have evidence for a fixed percentage uplift or guaranteed return on a gate installation.

Ask local estate agents or a valuer how the proposed entrance fits the property and its likely buyers. Describe the actual layout, parking space and maintenance requirements rather than asking about gates in general.
Make the entrance work well

A gate should leave suitable room for parking, turning and pedestrian access. Consider visitor calls, deliveries, bins and power cuts. Buyers may ask how easily the entrance works and what it costs to maintain.

Compare designs that suit the frontage and avoid sacrificing usable parking just to fit a preferred opening style. Our layout guide explains the space checks.
Keep the project evidence

Keep the permissions or relevant checks, product information, quotation, handover records and service history. Confirm whether warranties transfer and whether access accounts can be handed to a new owner.

Set the budget around the benefits you want and the installed gate cost guide. Treat any resale estimate as advice about your particular property, not a sales promise attached to the gate.

anthracite-grey-gate-trends-london.title: Choosing Anthracite Grey for Driveway Gates
anthracite-grey-gate-trends-london.description: Compare colour samples, sheen and surrounding materials before specifying an anthracite gate finish.
sections: Use a physical sample

Ask for the proposed coating colour reference, sheen and texture on the actual gate material. A screen image changes with display settings and lighting. Two finishes described as anthracite can look different beside brick, stone or render.

Place a sample outside in sun and shade. Check it beside existing window frames and doors rather than assuming that the same colour name guarantees a visual match.
Specify the complete entrance

Include gate leaves, posts, hinges, visible motor covers and the pedestrian entrance in the finish schedule. Ask which components come from different manufacturers and whether slight variations are expected.

For a wood-effect or two-tone design, inspect the joint between finishes and the rear face. Request a drawing showing the areas to receive each finish.
Compare upkeep and repair options

Ask for cleaning instructions, touch-up advice and written coating terms. Dark colour alone does not establish how much dust will show or how long the finish will last. Avoid choosing on unsourced trend or maintenance percentages.

Compare aluminium and other metal gates using the actual construction and coating specification. Bring your preferred sample when you discuss your entrance.

minimalist-steel-slat-gates-london.title: Steel Slat Driveway Gates: Privacy and Design Choices
minimalist-steel-slat-gates-london.description: Plan slat spacing, sightlines, frame details and safe movement for a contemporary entrance.
sections: View the gaps from more than one angle

Slat width, depth and spacing change how much you can see through the gate. Ask for a sample or drawing showing views from the street, inside the garden and approaching at an angle. A straight-on photograph may hide gaps visible from elsewhere.

Balance privacy with the view needed to leave the driveway. Include the height of a seated driver and pedestrians approaching along the pavement in the design discussion.
Draw the frame and rear face

Confirm the arrangement of frames, slats, joints and fixings on both sides. Ask how the pedestrian gate, posts and adjacent fencing will align. Horizontal and vertical designs can create different visual proportions, but neither orientation alone establishes structural performance.

Discuss any accessible openings or footholds as part of the entrance assessment. Decorative spacing is not a substitute for checking hazards around powered movement.
Specify structure and finish

A closely boarded gate needs assessment for dimensions, exposure, supports and drive requirements. Ask the fabricator to specify the actual metal and corrosion-protection system, including treatment of joints and cut edges.

Compare the proposed finish sample and written maintenance instructions. Explore metal gate options and colour selection before finalising the quotation.

do-i-need-a-dropped-kerb-for-a-driveway-.title: Do You Need a Dropped Kerb for a Driveway Gate?
do-i-need-a-dropped-kerb-for-a-driveway-.description: Check vehicle-crossing approval separately from gate planning, paving and ownership permissions.
sections: A gate does not authorise driving across a pavement

If vehicles will cross a public footway to reach the property, check the vehicle-crossing requirements with the highway authority. An existing opening, gravel drive or gate is not proof that the crossing is approved.

Use the GOV.UK dropped-kerb service to find the relevant council. Ask about an existing crossing as well as a proposed new or widened one.
Show the complete access arrangement

Provide photographs, the property address and a plan showing the gate, parking space, road and pavement. Identify street trees, utility covers, lamps and other features near the proposed crossing.

Ask the authority for its current eligibility rules, application process, approved work arrangements and charges. Do not book pavement work on the basis of another borough’s dimensions or a generic online price.
Keep the permissions separate

Check planning requirements for the gate and entrance, highway approval for the crossing, and ownership or lease restrictions. The responsible authority should confirm which processes apply to your address and road.

Paving and drainage need their own design. Read our front-garden paving guide and include approved crossover work and surface reinstatement in the installed gate cost guide.

front-garden-paving-suds-london.title: Front Garden Paving, Drainage and Driveway Gates
front-garden-paving-suds-london.description: Coordinate the paving, water route and gate foundations before changing a front garden entrance.
sections: Check the scope of the paving rules

Planning Portal explains that traditional impermeable front-garden paving over five square metres needs planning permission where water does not run to a permeable area. Its front-garden paving guidance also sets out limits and exceptions to permitted development.

Check property type, listed status, planning conditions and any Article 4 direction before assuming that a permeable surface settles the planning question. Ask the authority about the actual proposal.
Design where the water will go

Tell the contractor about ponding, flooding and the current falls. Ask for the proposed surface build-up, drainage route and maintenance arrangements. A permeable top surface needs a suitable underlying design to work as intended.

Coordinate the paving with gate tracks, motor boxes, supports and cable routes. Avoid setting final paving levels before those details have been agreed.
Treat the vehicle crossing separately

Changing the garden surface does not authorise driving across the public footway. Check the dropped-kerb requirements and any approval for a new or altered crossing.

Ask the quotation to distinguish paving, drainage, gate groundworks and highway work. Record who obtains each permission and who reinstates disturbed surfaces.
Keep the system maintainable

Request cleaning and care instructions for the selected paving and drainage. Identify covers and access points that must remain reachable after the gate is installed.

Consult the government’s permeable-surfacing guidance and use the installed gate cost guide to compare the complete entrance scope.

electric-gate-parcel-delivery-access-lon.title: Parcel and Delivery Access Through Electric Gates
electric-gate-parcel-delivery-access-lon.description: Choose a delivery routine that works when you are home, away or unable to answer an intercom.
sections: Choose where parcels should go

Decide whether a courier should enter the driveway or leave a parcel at an accessible delivery point outside the powered gate. Give clear instructions that do not require climbing, reaching through the gate or leaving goods in its movement path.

Consider pedestrian access and the position of a parcel box before adding an entry device. A delivery routine should also work when you cannot answer a call.
Manage codes and visitor calls

A keypad can offer temporary or separately managed codes if the selected product supports them. Check how codes expire and how you remove access. Avoid placing a permanent household code in public delivery notes.

A video or phone intercom lets you speak with the visitor, subject to the installed connection and app features. Notifications, recordings and remote release vary by model and account. Request a demonstration rather than assuming they are included.
Keep movement and access separate

Letting a visitor in does not confirm that the gate’s path is clear. The installation needs protective measures for the actual entrance, and users need instructions on where to wait and move. Do not ask a courier to hold a powered leaf open or obstruct a sensor.

Agree an alternative for network or power failure. Keep manual release to trained users following the supplied instructions, rather than sharing a generic release sequence with delivery drivers.
Choose the equipment around the routine
Compare keypad access, video entry and phone entry. Check account ownership and recurring charges in the quotation. Our gate safety guide explains the handover information to request.

electric-sliding-gates.title: Electric Sliding Gates
electric-sliding-gates.description: Electric sliding gates designed around your London driveway, side space, supports and access requirements.
sections: Make room for the whole gate

Sliding gates move alongside the entrance, which can help where a swing leaf would conflict with parked vehicles. The survey must measure the full travel path, supporting arrangement and separation from walls, fences and pedestrian areas.

Tracked, cantilever and telescopic configurations need different space. Ask for a drawing showing the clear opening, stored gate and any supporting tail. An opening-width-plus-500-mm rule does not fit every design.
Check levels, supports and drainage

Tell us about slopes, standing water and work planned for the driveway. The proposed support and travel arrangement must suit the ground and gate dimensions. Include foundations, track where applicable, cable routes and surface reinstatement in the written scope.

For restricted sites, compare telescopic gates with the wider swing and sliding options.
Specify access and safe movement

Choose the appearance, privacy and opening arrangement alongside visitor entry and pedestrian access. A powered gate needs assessment of the entire movement area, including the run-back zone. Request the proposed protective measures, checks and user instructions.

Agree manual-release arrangements, maintenance access and the actual operating sequence. Opening speed depends on the equipment and safe configuration; it is not a universal service promise.
Request a complete quotation

Send your postcode, photographs and approximate opening dimensions. We can discuss a survey and the work required. Confirm products, groundworks, electrical supply, controls, VAT, exclusions and handover in writing.

Use our installed gate cost guide to compare proposals. Ask for the proposed lead time and the written terms for gate, finish, automation and installation before ordering.
faqs: How much side space does a sliding gate need?
The required space depends on the tracked, cantilever or multi-panel design, supporting structure and protective clearances. Request a drawing of the complete travel and stored position.
Can a sliding gate work on a slope?
A survey must assess the travel path, levels, drainage, supports and safe manual movement. A sloping driveway does not automatically favour a particular sliding design.
How long will installation take?
Agree a programme after the measured design and groundworks are known. Fabrication, power and reinstatement can affect the schedule.

electric-swing-gates.title: Electric Swing Gates
electric-swing-gates.description: Single and paired electric swing gates planned around your opening, parking space and everyday access.
sections: Plan the path of each leaf

A swing gate needs space throughout its opening arc. The survey should show the actual hinge position, leaf length, parking position and pedestrian route. A pair of leaves shares the opening width, but that alone does not establish safe vehicle clearance.

Use our layout comparison to prepare for the survey. Where space is tight, compare sliding and folding alternatives before selecting the gate design.
Check gradients and boundaries

Rising ground can conflict with the swing path. The installer must assess levels and the way a released leaf can move under gravity or wind. A different motor does not remove a geometry problem.

Check the highway boundary and relevant planning requirements before choosing outward operation. Read our outward-opening gate guide and obtain advice for the actual property.
Choose the gate and automation together

Compare material, infill, supports and exposure alongside the proposed drive. Above-ground and underground operators have different installation and maintenance requirements. Ask for the product model and the basis for the proposed arrangement.

Include access controls, protective measures, completed-system checks and manual-release training in the scope. Keep the written user and maintenance instructions after handover.
Compare the complete cost

We can discuss design, supply and installation for your London property. Send photographs and approximate dimensions when you discuss your entrance.

Use the installed gate cost guide to compare gate fabrication, supports, electrical work, groundworks and reinstatement. Confirm the timetable, exclusions and separate warranty terms before accepting.
faqs: Should swing gates open inward?

The site layout, boundary and highway requirements need checking. Do not let a proposed leaf sweep over a public pavement or road without resolving the legal and safety implications with the relevant authority.
What width should I choose?
Measure vehicle turning, the clear opening, supports and pedestrian use. A standard width cannot establish suitability for every driveway.
Are swing gates always cheaper than sliding gates?
Compare complete quotations for your entrance. Supports, groundworks, gate design and controls can change the relative cost.

wooden-driveway-gates.title: Wooden Driveway Gates
wooden-driveway-gates.description: Timber driveway gates for London homes, with the species, construction, finish and upkeep agreed before ordering.
sections: Choose the timber and appearance

Start with a sample and a drawing of the complete gate. Compare grain, board layout, frame proportions and how the finish will look beside the house. Ask for the species or modified-wood product in the quotation.

Hardwood, softwood and modified timber describe different options, not a fixed lifespan. Availability, construction and exposure matter. Our Accoya guide explains the difference between material and gate warranties.
Plan construction and automation

Discuss the dimensions, joints, supports and hardware with the installer. A timber gate can be considered for automation after assessment of its condition, geometry, dimensions, exposure and surrounding hazards. Motor selection involves more than weight alone.

Confirm which work the proposal includes for hinges, posts, power and protective measures. Where you are replacing an existing gate, compare the cost of retaining or renewing the supports.
Agree the finish and care

Choose whether you want a painted finish, visible grain or a changing weathered appearance. Request the coating system and care instructions for the selected timber and exposure.

Confirm the separate terms for timber, fabrication, coating, hardware and installation. A material guarantee does not automatically include repainting or call-out labour. Ask how maintenance affects those terms.
Compare your options

Use our wooden and aluminium comparison if you are also considering wood-effect metal. Compare samples and complete scope rather than a universal durability claim.

Send your postcode, preferred design and entrance photographs to discuss your entrance. We will discuss the proposed work and written quotation.
faqs: How long do wooden gates last?
Condition over time depends on the timber, construction, finish, exposure and care. Request the proposed product specification and terms rather than relying on a universal number of years.
Can wooden gates be automated?
Potentially, after assessment of the complete gate, supports, geometry and hazards. Motor capacity alone does not establish suitability.
Which timber should I choose?
Compare samples, construction, finish care and the written terms for the available species or modified-wood product.

metal-driveway-gates.title: Metal Driveway Gates
metal-driveway-gates.description: Compare metal driveway gate designs, fabrication and finish options for your London entrance.
sections: Specify the actual metal

A traditional iron-style appearance may use modern steel, while other designs use aluminium. Ask the quotation to identify the material, sections, joints and infill. Appearance alone does not establish what the gate is made from.

Compare open bars with a more screened design, considering the view from both sides and the surrounding frontage. Our slat-gate guide covers spacing and sightlines.
Ask how the finish protects the gate

Request the preparation and coating specification, including joints, edges and areas affected by fabrication. Galvanising, painting and powder coating are different processes; confirm which apply to the proposed gate.

No blanket rust-proof or maintenance-free promise replaces that specification. Ask for cleaning and inspection instructions, repair options and written coating terms. Compare physical colour samples before ordering.
Match the layout to the site

Choose swing or sliding operation around space, levels, supports and daily access. The dimensions and infill affect exposure and the requirements for powered movement. Include protective measures and maintenance access in the design.

If you have old metal gates, consider a restoration assessment before replacement. Listed or protected boundaries need their own checks.
Compare the written scope

Discuss aluminium or other metal options using the same opening and design requirements. The quotation should identify fabrication, supports, groundworks, controls, VAT and reinstatement.

Send your entrance photographs and postcode when you discuss your entrance. Confirm products and warranty terms in writing before ordering.
faqs: Are all metal gates galvanised?
Do not assume so. Confirm the actual metal and preparation/coating system in the quotation.
Can you restore an existing iron-style gate?
A specialist needs to identify the material, condition and repair scope before advising whether restoration is suitable.
Are metal gates maintenance-free?
No. Follow the supplied care instructions for the finish, fittings and any automation.

anpr-systems.title: ANPR Gate Entry Systems
anpr-systems.description: Number-plate entry planned around camera position, authorised vehicles, safe waiting and access-data management.
sections: Plan the approach and fallback

ANPR reads a vehicle registration and checks it against access permissions. It does not establish who is driving or prevent a second vehicle following the first. Decide where the driver waits and how entry works if a plate is not read.

Do not assume a vehicle can drive through without stopping. Camera recognition, the command to the controller and safe gate movement are separate parts of the sequence. Include visitors, deliveries and pedestrian access in the plan.
Check recognition at the actual entrance

Survey camera position, approach angle, lighting, headlight glare, stopping distance and the expected plate types. Ask the supplier to demonstrate the proposed equipment under the conditions that matter at your site.

A manufacturer’s performance figure under defined test conditions is not a guarantee for every vehicle or weather condition. Agree a keypad, intercom or other authorised fallback.
Manage permissions and records

Decide who can add, remove and review authorised registrations. Confirm expiry for temporary vehicles, administrator access and account recovery. Ask whether the system records images or events, where it stores them and how long it keeps them.

Where data-protection law applies, the operator must address the purpose, lawful use, notice, retention and access controls. Consult ICO video-surveillance guidance. A product label does not make the whole installation compliant.
Specify the complete installation

Include camera and controller models, network and power, gate interface, subscriptions, commissioning and user training. Confirm ongoing support and the effect of connection or power failure.

Compare video entry and keypads for visitors. Send your entrance layout and expected use when you discuss your entrance.
faqs: Will ANPR read every plate?
Recognition depends on the camera, setup, approach, lighting, plate condition and supported plate formats. Test the actual proposal and agree a fallback.
Can cars enter without stopping?
Do not assume this. The design must provide a suitable approach and waiting arrangement while recognition and safe gate movement take place.
Does ANPR replace gate safety devices?
No. Permission to enter is separate from the protective measures and checks required for the powered entrance.

video-intercoms.title: Video Intercom Systems
video-intercoms.description: See and speak to visitors through a video-entry system specified for your gate, network and household.
sections: Choose where calls should ring

Discuss indoor monitors, phones and the people who need to answer. Confirm whether you need live video only, recordings or gate-position feedback. These functions vary by product and configuration.

Ask to see the proposed call and release sequence, including what happens when nobody answers. Plan deliveries and pedestrian access alongside vehicle entry.
Check the site connection

Survey power, cable routes, camera position, lighting and the required network connection. App access may depend on broadband or a mobile service as well as power at the entrance.

Confirm the exact interface with the gate controller. An intercom is not automatically compatible with every existing motor or control board. Changes need assessment and commissioning with the complete entrance.
Keep control of accounts and recordings

Agree who owns the administrator account, how residents are added and removed, and how recovery works. Confirm subscriptions, storage, recording settings and any remote-access charges.

Position cameras with neighbouring property and the public area in mind. Ask what privacy controls apply and obtain advice on the responsibilities of the operator where needed.
Compare the specified equipment

Use our intercom buying guide and documented product comparison. Confirm offered brands and model availability in your quotation.

Send photographs and any safely accessible equipment details when you discuss your entrance. Include installation, programming, user training and support in the agreed scope.
faqs: Can a video intercom work with my existing gate?
The installer needs to check the existing controller, wiring, condition and proposed interface. Compatibility cannot be promised from the motor brand alone.
Can I answer remotely?
Some configurations support remote calls through an app. Confirm the required connection, account, charges and failure arrangements for the specified model.
Does every system record visitors?
No. Recording, event logs, storage and subscriptions vary. Request the exact functions and privacy settings.

gsm-phone-entry.title: GSM Phone Entry Systems
gsm-phone-entry.description: Phone-based gate entry with the device, signal, SIM plan and user permissions checked for your entrance.
sections: Decide how phone entry should work

Discuss whether you want authorised callers to request opening, a visitor intercom that calls residents, or both. Ask how the proposed system identifies a caller and what happens if nobody answers.

A phone command does not confirm physical gate position. Agree how the household recognises a failed opening and how visitors obtain help.
Confirm the supported network and plan

Identify the exact device and the voice, SMS or data services it needs. Check the SIM provider’s requirements, tariff and account-expiry conditions. Calls or messages should not be described as universally free.

Read Ofcom’s mobile-network retirement guidance and obtain product-specific support information. The word GSM is often used for phone entry generally; confirm which network technology the proposed unit actually uses.
Survey signal and fallback access

Test the proposed service at the equipment location. Plan the power supply, antenna and cable route. A phone on a different network is not a complete signal test for the installation.

Phone entry may avoid dependence on home Wi-Fi, but it still depends on its own network, equipment and power. Agree a fallback for outages and confirm any backup maintenance.
Hand over account control

Record who owns the SIM and administrator account. Demonstrate adding and removing users using the supplied instructions. Confirm recurring charges and how support handles a change of phone number or ownership.

Read the phone-entry buying checklist or compare intercom options before you discuss your entrance.
faqs: Will any SIM work?
Check the model, supported network services and tariff terms together. Not every SIM or plan supports every gate device.
Is phone entry independent of power and broadband?
It may not need home broadband, but the gate and phone-entry equipment still need power and the required mobile service.
Are opening calls free?
That depends on how the product handles calls and the applicable tariffs. Confirm the charges rather than assuming a missed-call arrangement.

keypad-entry-systems.title: Keypad Entry Systems
keypad-entry-systems.description: Code-based gate access with user management, weather exposure and controller compatibility specified for your property.
sections: Choose how you will manage codes

Decide who needs permanent access and who should have temporary permission. Ask whether the selected keypad supports separate users, expiry or time windows. Those functions vary by model.

Avoid one shared code for everyone if you need to remove an individual’s access. Agree who can change settings and how you recover administrator control.
Place the keypad for its users

Discuss pedestrian and driver use, reach, lighting and the position relative to moving leaves. Visitors should not need to reach through a gate or stand in its movement path to enter a code.

Confirm the enclosure rating, operating conditions and mounting requirements for the actual product. There is no single weather rating we can promise for every proposed keypad.
Check the gate connection

The installer needs to assess the control interface, power, wiring and the existing gate’s condition. Code acceptance requests entry; it does not replace the protective measures needed for powered movement.

Ask what happens after repeated incorrect attempts, loss of power or a controller fault. Agree an authorised alternative for residents and visitors.
Include setup and handover

Request model details, programming, instructions and written support terms. At handover, practise adding and removing a user, replacing the initial codes and recovering access.

Compare video entry for visitors you want to speak with and our delivery-access guide for couriers. Then discuss your entrance.
faqs: Can delivery codes expire automatically?
Some models support expiry or time schedules. Specify that requirement and have the supplier demonstrate it before accepting the configuration.
How many users can I add?
Capacity and whether users have separate codes depend on the selected model. Confirm the limit in the product specification.
Can a keypad be fitted to an existing gate?
Compatibility, power, wiring and safe operation need assessment before installation.
